title: Docs: give the Setup app's own books an audience, so only users who can open Setup can read them, not just see them listed
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUkbQqRUUFSiu2HGob

Follow-up from #35424 item 8 (「系统包…只给管理员看」), split off by the seat when PR #36027 was built (claim reading 2; L2 record F1 on that PR). Under epic #34571.

## What changes with PR #36027

The "All docs" page lists a `com.objectstack.*` system package's books only when the caller's launcher holds that package's app (Setup needs `setup.access`). That is a **listing** rule. The Setup overview book declares no audience, so a member without `setup.access` can still open an article at its address, and the page's `?include=content` answer carries its body for search.

The content is product help text and carries nothing sensitive today. But "only admins see it" in the card reads as "only admins can read it", and the listing rule alone does not give that.

## To do

1. Give the platform's own Setup-facing books an `audience` that the existing per-caller gate on the doc list and the doc read already honours (`packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts`), so they are neither listed nor readable without Setup access.
2. Check the other `com.objectstack.*` books for the same need, and say which ones stay readable by everyone (for example, end-user help).
3. Pin both doors: the list (with and without `include=content`) and the single-doc read.

## Acceptance

- A member without `setup.access` gets the Setup books in neither the list nor the read, nor in the search's content answer. An admin sees and reads them as today.

Blocked-by: #36027
